scenes.action: The design team, in work clothes round a long table, turns a long paper strip lined with card benches end for end, and it reads the same, with gates marked along both edges. An operator representative in the operator's jacket sweeps a hand across the strip in one motion, from the pier edge to the benches.
scenes.sound: Paper sliding on the table, a hand brushing across card.
scenes.camera: Standing at the end of the long table, the camera looks down along the paper strip and holds still while the hands turn it and sweep across it.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The one rule every later stage defends is settled here: people move on and off across the width.
scenes.leads_to: The agreed arrangement leaves the studio as drawings of a hull with matching ends and open sides.

beats.action: The design team turns the paper strip end for end.
beats.visible_result: The reversed strip reads the same, card benches across it and gate marks along both long edges.

beats.action: An operator representative sweeps a hand across the strip from the pier edge to the benches.
beats.visible_result: One hand crosses the whole strip over the card benches in a single motion.

scenes.light_and_weather: Daylight from the tall windows along one wall falls across the table, with the pendant lamps on above it.

scenes.action: Yard crews in overalls and hard hats set out both end frames of the hull from one steel template on the building blocks. Over the following weeks posts rise along each side as a row of openings, and the roof closes over the hall while the sides are still bare.
scenes.sound: Template boards laid on steel, posts set down on steel, then roof panels lowered and bolted.
scenes.camera: From the top of a staging tower along one wall, the camera looks along the hull on its blocks and pans slowly from one end frame to the other.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The matching ends and the sides built as openings are the design becoming structure, and both are made so from the first frame.
scenes.leads_to: The roofed hull, still on its blocks, passes to the fitting-out crews.

beats.action: Yard crews set out both end frames from the same steel template.
beats.visible_result: Two matching end frames stand at either end of the building blocks.

beats.action: Posts rise along each side between the end frames and the roof closes over the hall while the sides are still bare.
beats.visible_result: A closed roof spans the hull above two rows of open bays.
beats.time_jump: Weeks later, with both ends framed.

start.progress: Nothing of the hull built yet; the building blocks stand empty along the dock floor.

end.progress: Hull framed with matching ends on its blocks in the dry dock; each side a row of open bays between posts; roof closed over the hall; no gates and no glazing.

scenes.light_and_weather: Daylight from the roof lights along the ridge and the floodlights on the staging towers fall on the open framing.

scenes.action: With the hull still on its blocks in the dry dock, fitting-out crews with tool belts hang the gates one by one along both sides, sliding each shut against the one before it. Days later the coated hull stands with both sides closed into one surface and the helm cabin glazed toward both ends, and one of the crew runs a hand along the seams of a closed side.
scenes.sound: Gates rolling on their runners and meeting their neighbours with a soft knock.
scenes.camera: Low on the dock floor beside the blocks, the camera tracks slowly along one side of the hull as the gates close one after another.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: Each open side has to become a wall that can close; this is where it becomes one surface, before the ferry ever touches water.
scenes.leads_to: The coated ferry, finished inside and out, stands ready on its blocks to be floated out.

beats.action: Fitting-out crews hang the gates one by one along both sides, sliding each shut against the one before it.
beats.visible_result: Each side closes into a single row of gates meeting edge to edge.

beats.action: One of the crew runs a hand along the seams of a closed side of the coated hull.
beats.visible_result: The coated hull stands on its blocks with both sides closed into one surface.
beats.time_jump: Days later, with every gate hung, the hull and roof coated and the helm cabin glazed toward both ends.

start.progress: Hull framed with matching ends on its blocks in the dry dock; each side a row of open bays between posts; roof closed over the hall; no gates and no glazing.

end.progress: Hull and roof coated; gates hung along the port and starboard sides and meeting edge to edge when closed; helm cabin glazed toward both ends; standing on its blocks in the dry dock.

scenes.light_and_weather: Light from the roof lights along the ridge and the floodlights on the staging towers falls along the closed side.

scenes.action: Yard crews open the flooding culverts and water rises along the closed sides of the coated, finished ferry until it lifts off its blocks and floats. Hours later the dock gate swings open and the yard crews warp the ferry out through it into the harbour, its gates closed along both sides, while the master, in a dark uniform jacket, watches from the helm cabin at mid-length.
scenes.sound: Water rushing in through the culverts, then mooring lines creaking as the ferry moves toward the open gate.
scenes.camera: From the walkway on the dock gate, the camera looks down the dock at the ferry's end and holds while the water rises, then turns to follow it out through the gate.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The finished ferry goes afloat for the first time and leaves the yard as one coherent vessel, its closed sides reading as walls from the water.
scenes.leads_to: The ferry leaves the yard for its home pier and goes into service.

beats.action: Yard crews open the flooding culverts and the water rises along the closed sides until the ferry lifts off its blocks.
beats.visible_result: The finished ferry floats in the flooded dock, clear of its blocks.

beats.action: The dock gate swings open and the yard crews warp the ferry out into the harbour while the master watches from the helm cabin.
beats.visible_result: The ferry passes through the open dock gate onto the harbour water with both sides closed.
beats.time_jump: Hours later, with the dock full.

start.progress: Coated and complete: gates, folding rails, cross benches, helm cabin and crew stair in place; standing on its blocks in the dry building dock.

end.progress: Coated and complete; afloat, leaving the building dock through its gate into the harbour.

scenes.light_and_weather: Light from the roof lights and the floodlights on the staging towers, with grey daylight spreading in through the opening gate.

scenes.action: At the home pier the gates slide open along the pier side, worked by the master from the helm cabin, while two deck hands in high-visibility vests fold the rails down flat, and the waiting crowd, with bags and coffee cups, steps aboard across the whole width at once. A few minutes later, with everyone seated and the gate line clear, the gates close and the ferry pulls away.
scenes.sound: Gates running open together and footsteps crossing the threshold at once; later the gates meeting and engines taking up.
scenes.camera: From the waiting area on the pier, the camera looks along the open side as the crowd crosses it, then holds still as the gates close.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The film's question is first answered in use: a whole crowd boards together.
scenes.leads_to: The ferry heads out across the harbour with a full hall.

beats.action: The gates slide open along the pier side while two deck hands fold the rails down flat and the waiting crowd steps aboard across the whole width at once.
beats.visible_result: The pier side stands open with its rails flat and the crowd crossing it shoulder to shoulder.

beats.action: With the gate line clear, the deck hands swing the rails up, the gates close and the ferry pulls away.
beats.visible_result: The pier side is closed in front of a full hall and the ferry is moving off.
beats.time_jump: A few minutes later, with every passenger aboard and seated.

start.progress: Complete and in service, lying at the home pier.

end.progress: Complete and in service, pulling away from the home pier.

scenes.light_and_weather: A bright, breezy day over the pier, the lamp posts along the boarding edge unlit.

scenes.action: Out on open water, spray strikes the closed gates along the windward side while the passengers who boarded together read and talk on the benches beside them.
scenes.sound: Spray against the closed side, low talk, a page turning.
scenes.camera: Seated at the end of a bench, the camera looks along the closed windward side and holds steady with the motion of the ferry.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The open side has closed into shelter, and the people sitting beside it show it without a word.
scenes.leads_to: The ferry comes into the far pier.

beats.action: Spray strikes the closed gates along the windward side while the passengers read and talk on the benches beside them.
beats.visible_result: Water streams down the glazing of the closed gates beside seated passengers.

start.progress: Complete and in service, under way across the harbour.

end.progress: Complete and in service, under way across the harbour.

scenes.light_and_weather: Daylight through the glazing of the closed gates; outside, a fresh wind throws spray against the windward side.

scenes.action: Beyond the glazing of the closed gates the far pier slides alongside. Before the ferry stops, the passengers fold their papers, stand and wait in front of the closed leaves along the pier side, each where an opening will be.
scenes.sound: Engines easing, fenders touching the pier, papers folded, footsteps settling at the gate line.
scenes.camera: From the middle of the hall, the camera looks toward the pier-side gates and holds still as the passengers stand up in front of them.
scenes.why_it_cannot_be_cut: The ending answers the premise: the passengers no longer treat the side as a wall, they already stand where it will open.

beats.action: Beyond the glazing of the closed gates, the far pier slides alongside.
beats.visible_result: The pier edge passes behind the glass of the closed gates.

beats.action: Before it stops, the passengers fold their papers, stand and wait in front of the closed leaves along the pier side.
beats.visible_result: A line of standing passengers faces the closed gates along the pier side.

start.progress: Complete and in service, coming alongside the far pier.

end.progress: Complete and in service, alongside the far pier.

scenes.light_and_weather: Daylight through the glazing of the closed gates; beyond them the far pier, with the wind dropping in its lee.

coverage.evidence: An operator representative sweeps a hand across the paper strip in one motion, from the pier edge to the benches.
The strip reads the same end for end, with gates marked along both edges for boarding across the width.
Both end frames are set out from the same steel template.
Each side rises as a row of openings with posts between them while the roof closes over the hall.
The gates are hung one by one, each sliding shut against its neighbour, until a closed side reads as one surface.
The benches and rails are fitted inside the hall off screen: the hull stands with its sides closed in sc_03 and is complete when the dock is flooded in sc_04.
The dock is flooded, the coated, finished ferry floats off its blocks and is warped out through the dock gate into the harbour.
The operator takes over the ferry off screen: it leaves the dock in sc_04 and is in service at the home pier in sc_05.
A waiting crowd steps aboard across the width at once at the home pier.
Passengers read and talk on the benches beside the closed gates as spray strikes them.
Under way, passengers fill the cross benches between the two rows of gates, and at the far pier they stand at the closed pier-side gates.
